declarations.description:
A pivot table: it groups flat rows by the fields set on `rows` and `columns` and aggregates `values` in every cell,
with subtotals and totals, as a spreadsheet's pivot does.

Each `values` entry is `{ field, aggregate, label, format }`: the aggregate is `sum` (the default), `count`, `avg`,
`min`, `max` or `distinct`, and `format` takes `Intl.NumberFormat` options. Several values split each column. Row
groups expand and collapse (`expand-depth` sets how deep they start open), with a subtotal under each open group
(`subtotals`) and a grand total row and column (`totals`). Clicking a column header sorts the rows by it. `heatmap`
tints each cell by its value.

With `configurable`, a field list beside the grid lets the reader drag fields between rows, columns and values (or
move them from each field's menu) and change a value's aggregate; `pivot-change` gives the new layout.
`cell-click` gives the records behind a cell, for drill-down, and `toCSV()` exports what is shown. `pivot()` is the
same computation as a plain function.

The grid is a `treegrid`: the arrow keys move between cells, Left and Right close and open a group, and Enter on a
value cell fires `cell-click`.

members.name: data
members.description: The rows to summarise.

members.name: rows
members.description: The fields grouped down the side, outermost first.

members.name: columns
members.description: The fields grouped across the top, outermost first.

members.name: values
members.description: The measures: `{ field, aggregate, label, format }`.

members.name: fieldLabels
members.description: Labels for fields, by field name, used in headers and the field list.

members.name: expandDepth
members.description: How many row levels start open.

members.name: subtotals
members.description: Where an open group's subtotal goes: `bottom`, `top` or `none`.

members.name: totals
members.description: Which grand totals to show: `both`, `rows`, `columns` or `none`.

members.name: heatmap
members.description: Tints each cell by its value within its measure.

members.name: configurable
members.description: Shows the field list, so the reader can change the layout.

members.name: label
members.description: The grid's accessible name.

members.name: locale
members.description: The locale for numbers; the nearest `lang` when empty.

members.name: formatters
members.description: One number format per value, for the render under way.

members.name: config
members.description: The layout as configured now.

members.name: expandAll
members.description: Opens every row group.

members.name: collapseAll
members.description: Closes every row group.

members.name: toCSV
members.description: The grid as shown, as CSV: one header line per column level, then a line per row.

members.name: cellValue
members.description: The value a row shows in a column.

members.name: ordered
members.description: Children in the order shown: by the sorted column's values, else by label.

members.name: allFields
members.description: Every field of the data, in the order first seen.

members.name: move
members.description: Moves a field to a zone, as a drop or a menu command does, and says so.

members.name: setAggregate
members.description: Changes the aggregate of the value at `index`: two values may share a field.
